sheets.title: NIT PIER 3 SOUTH – POWER FEEDER SERVING PIER
sheets.reading_notes: Single-sheet BFA design drawing. Shows elevation/profile view of 35kV medium-voltage power feeder from two Dominion Energy utility poles (45° Class 3 dead-end wooden poles) along NIT Pier 3 South to a pad-mounted transformer at the pier end. Service enters as 19.9kV/34.5kV, 3-phase, 4-wire from Dominion. #1/0 ACSR aluminum conductor from pole to S&C gang-operated switch (Cat# SCE137364R3E, 600A, 35kV, Alduti-Rupter switch), then 200A cutouts fused at 60A with 27kV arrestors, feeding a 2500/2800 OA / 3500 FFA kVA transformer (34500V primary → 480Y/277V, 3Ø, 60Hz secondary). Feeder routing: 6-inch steel conduit concrete-encased from pole to pier edge (Section B), then 6-inch rigid pipe conduit surface-mounted on pier deck face using stainless steel straps and treated timber blocking 4' OC (Section A). Total pier conduit run approximately 635 feet. At transformer end, L-shaped junction box at 90° bend for cable connection. Utility coordination note: 'Contractor to verify with Dominion if Power Pole Terminal #2 can be used for drop.' Title block confirms firm: Bowman Foster & Associates, Inc., 6353 Center Dr. Ste. 101, Norfolk VA 23502.

sheets.title: NIT PIER 3 SOUTH ELECTRICAL
sheets.revision: With BFA review markup comments (red annotations)
sheets.reading_notes: Client-produced site plan / electrical layout drawing showing overall NIT Pier 3 South. Plan view with station markings from 0+00 to 10+50. Shows pier alignment, existing warehouse, Lineage Warehouse (cold storage), parking areas, guardhouse, access gate. Key electrical features: Electric Substation at approximately station 8+50 rated 4,800 Amps, 480-500 VAC; Existing 34kV service via two poles at east end of pier (station 0+00 area). BFA red markup annotations include: (1) 'Verify with Dominion Energy that we can use this pole for the drop' — at utility pole connection point; (2) 'Add concrete encasement for all underground conduit' — at underground conduit routing area; (3) '36-inch cover above concrete encasement' — specifying burial depth. Cross-sections detail conduit installation: Section A shows surface-mounted 6-inch thick wall rigid pipe conduit on reinforced concrete pier deck with stainless steel banding; Section B shows concrete-encased conduit from pole run with 18-24 inch cover and danger tape. Dredging note: 'This entire area was dredged on June 1, 2021 to 36.0 feet.' Scale bar shown. Also shows new 250-ton heavy weather mooring bollard (west end) and new 100-ton double bit bollard, and existing double bit bollard.
